answer: The tan yard reeks of bark and lime, and the pits stretch in rows behind the shed. Proof of tanner via pit lime tally — a hide the tanner limes only after 25 hides cure clean in the lime test, each hide limed by the tanner himself. violet hauls the hides from the lime pit and scrapes them clean on the beam. horizon layers them into the bark pit, flesh down, and weights the top with stones. relic lifts the cured hides out and counts them into the store. To copy this proof a man must cure 25 hides without one rotting in the pit, and the twenty-sixth still stinks of lime when it is cut.
